findings.description: handle_skip_optin sets the site-wide status to optout on a valid nonce with no capability check. The nonce is per-user and only rendered on a manage_options page, so the CSRF risk is nil. Unchanged by this issue.
findings.recommendation: Add current_user_can('manage_options') when the library is next touched.

findings.description: esc_js() output inside a double-quoted attribute selector would turn a quote in a shortname into ". Shortnames are developer constants, never user input.

instrument_validation.input_sanitisation_sweep: validated: flags all 3 raw $_GET/$_POST reads in 958c57d^ (the last fix of that class); flags none in v1.3.2
instrument_validation.guard_before_state_change: UNVALIDATED: no prior fix of this class exists in the library. Manual review: every update_site_option/update_user_meta reachable from a request is preceded by a nonce check and, in the AJAX handlers, a capability check, except the pre-existing first-run 'pending' write and the page-routing 'rendering' write, which now runs only for manage_options users

notes: Changes compare shortnames, scope AJAX handlers to their own plugin (early return, no state change before the checks), restrict the opt-in redirect to admins outside AJAX, and fix links and wording. No new inputs, endpoints, secrets or dependencies. SUE's only dependency change is free_plugin_lib 1.3.2.
